==Polish==

===Etymology===
{{ety|pl|:inh|zlw-opl:znaleźć|tree=+|text=+}} {{surf|pl|z-|naleźć}}. This word is {{lg|suppletive}} with {{m|pl|znajść}} (< {{cog|zlw-opl|znajć}}), which has a similar meaning and where the future forms with ''znajd-'' come from.<ref>{{R:pl:Boryś}}</ref><ref>{{R:pl:Mańczak}}</ref>

===Pronunciation===
{{pl-pr|a=Pl-#.ogg<text:#>;LL-Q809 (pol)-Olaf-#.wav<text:#>;LL-Q809 (pol)-Olaf-# się.wav<text:~>|mp=#}}

===Verb===
{{pl-verb|pf|impf=znajdować}}

# {{lb|pl|transitive}} to [[find]] {{gl|to determine the location of a person or thing}}
#: {{syn|pl|odnaleźć}}
#: {{uxa|pl|'''Znalazłem''' mapę skarbu.|I '''found''' the treasure map.}}
# {{lb|pl|transitive}} to [[find]] {{gl|to acquire or invent something needed}}
#: {{uxa|pl|'''Znalazłem''' synonim, którego szukałem.|I '''found''' the synonym i was looking for.}}
# {{lb|pl|transitive}} to [[find]] {{gl|to claim pressence of or see something or someone somewhere; to come across}}
#: {{syn|pl|spotkać}}
#: {{uxa|pl|'''Znalazłem''' pieniążek na ulicy.|I '''found''' a coin on the street.}}
# {{lb|pl|transitive}} to [[find]], to [[come across]], to [[run into]] {{gl|to encounter someone in a particular state}}
# {{lb|pl|transitive}} to [[find]], to [[work up]] {{gl|to summon up or muster i.e. courage}}
#: {{syn|pl|[[zdobyć]] [[się]]}}
#: {{uxa|pl|W końcu '''znajdziesz''' w sobie odwagę, by wyjawić swe uczucia..|At some point you will '''find''' the courage to confess.}}
# {{lb|pl|transitive|archaic}} to [[find]] {{gl|to assess the state of something}}
# {{lb|pl|intransitive}} {{ng|used as a [[light verb]] with [[deverbal]] [[noun]]s or [[gerund]]s to indicate the beginning of said verb}}
# {{lb|pl|reflexive-się}} to [[end up]] somewhere {{gl|to go to a certain place or to a certain group}}
#: {{uxa|pl|Nagle, '''znalazłem się''' wśród motocyklistów.|Suddenly, I '''found myself''' among motorcyclists.}}
# {{lb|pl|reflexive-się}} to [[find oneself]] somewhere {{gl|to be in some situation or state}}
#: {{uxa|pl|'''Znalazłem się''' w nieprzyjemnej sytuacji.|I '''was''' in an unpleasant situation.}}
# {{lb|pl|reflexive-się}} to be [[find|found]] {{gl|to be acquired or thought up}}
#: {{syn|pl|[[najść]] [[się]]}}
# {{lb|pl|reflexive-się}} to be [[find|found]] {{gl|after going missing, to be discovered again}}
#: {{syn|pl|[[odnaleźć]] [[się]]}}
#: {{ant|pl|zaginąć|zginąć}}
#: {{uxa|pl|Poszukiwana dziewczyna '''znalazła się''' po 3 dniach poszukiwań.|The girl we were looking for was '''found''' after 3 days of searching for her.}}

===Verb===
{{pl-verb|pf}}

# {{lb|pl|reflexive-się|of people}} to [[behave]] [[properly]]
# {{lb|pl|copulative|reflexive-się|obsolete}} to [[become]] {{+obj|pl|ins<whom/what>}}
